name: Codecov
description: GitHub Action that uploads coverage reports for your repository to codecov.io

base_sha.description: The base SHA to select. This is only used in the "pr-base-picking" run command

binary.description: The file location of a pre-downloaded version of the CLI. If specified, integrity checking will be bypassed.

codecov_yml_path.description: The location of the codecov.yml file. This is crrently ONLY used for automated test selection (https://docs.codecov.com/docs/getting-started-with-ats). Note tha

commit_parent.description: SHA (with 40 chars) of what should be the parent of this commit.

directory.description: Folder to search for coverage files. Default to the current working directory

disable_file_fixes.description: Disable file fixes to ignore common lines from coverage (e.g. blank lines or empty brackets). Read more here https://docs.codecov.com/docs/fixing-reports

disable_search.description: Disable search for coverage files. This is helpful when specifying what files you want to upload with the files option.

disable_safe_directory.description: Disable setting safe directory. Set to true to disable.

disable_telem.description: Disable sending telemetry data to Codecov. Set to true to disable.

env_vars.description: Environment variables to tag the upload with (e.g. PYTHON | OS,PYTHON)

exclude.description: Comma-separated list of folders to exclude from search.

fail_ci_if_error.description: On error, exit with non-zero code

files.description: Comma-separated list of explicit files to upload. These will be added to the coverage files found for upload. If you wish to only upload the specified files, pl

flags.description: Comma-separated list of flags to upload to group coverage metrics.

force.description: Only used for empty-upload run command

gcov_args.description: Extra arguments to pass to gcov

gcov_executable.description: gcov executable to run. Defaults to 'gcov'

gcov_ignore.description: Paths to ignore during gcov gathering

gcov_include.description: Paths to include during gcov gathering

handle_no_reports_found.description: If no coverage reports are found, do not raise an exception.

name.description: Custom defined name of the upload. Visible in the Codecov UI

network_filter.description: Specify a filter on the files listed in the network section of the Codecov report. This will only add files whose path begin with the specified filter. Useful f

network_prefix.description: Specify a prefix on files listed in the network section of the Codecov report. Useful to help resolve path fixing.

os.description: Override the assumed OS. Options available at cli.codecov.io

override_branch.description: Specify the branch to be displayed with this commit on Codecov

override_build_url.description: The URL of the build where this is running

override_pr.description: Specify the pull request number manually. Used to override pre-existing CI environment variables.

plugins.description: Comma-separated list of plugins to run. Specify `noop` to turn off all plugins

recurse_submodules.description: Whether to enumerate files inside of submodules for path-fixing purposes. Off by default.

report_code.description: The code of the report if using local upload. If unsure, leave default. Read more here https://docs.codecov.com/docs/the-codecov-cli#how-to-use-local-upload

report_type.description: The type of file to upload, coverage by default. Possible values are "test_results", "coverage".

root_dir.description: Root folder from which to consider paths on the network section. Defaults to current working directory.

run_command.description: Choose which CLI command to run. Options are "upload-coverage", "empty-upload", "pr-base-picking", "send-notifications". "upload-coverage" is run by default.

skip_validation.description: Skip integrity checking of the CLI. This is NOT recommended.

slug.description: [Required when using the org token] Set to the owner/repo slug used instead of the private repo token. Only applicable to some Enterprise users.

swift_project.description: Specify the swift project name. Useful for optimization.

token.description: Repository Codecov token. Used to authorize report uploads

url.description: Set to the Codecov instance URl. Used by Dedicated Enterprise Cloud customers.

use_oidc.description: Use OIDC instead of token. This will ignore any token supplied

use_pypi.description: Use the pypi version of the CLI instead of from cli.codecov.io

version.description: Which version of the Codecov CLI to use (defaults to 'latest')

working-directory.description: Directory in which to execute codecov.sh
